macros.name: aftercolumnseparator
macros.doc: You can redefine \beforecolumnseparator and \aftercolumnseparator length to define spaces before or after the column separator, instead of letting reledpar calculate them automatically.

macros.name: AtBeginPairs
macros.doc: You can use the macro \AtBeginPairs to insert a code at the beginning of each pairs environments.

macros.name: AtEveryPstartCall
macros.doc: The \AtEveryPstartCall argument is called when the \pstartL or \pstartR is called.

macros.name: beforecolumnseparator
macros.doc: You can redefine \beforecolumnseparator and \aftercolumnseparator length to define spaces before or after the column separator, instead of letting reledpar calculate them automatically.

macros.name: columnrulewidth
macros.doc: The width of the rule is \columnrulewidth (initially 0pt so the rule is invisible).

macros.name: Columns
macros.doc: The command \Columns typesets the texts in the previous pair of Leftside and Rightside environments.

macros.name: columnseparator
macros.doc: The separator between line pairs in parallel columns is in the form of a vertical rule extending a little below the baseline and with a height slightly greater than the \baselineskip.

macros.name: dolineLhook
macros.doc: \dolineLhook and \dolineRhook are the equivalent to the reledmac \dolinehook, respectively for left and right side.

macros.name: edtextlater
macros.doc: \edtextlater and \edtextnow are used to print critical footnotes on the right side, while refering to the text on the left side.

macros.name: edtextnow
macros.doc: \edtextlater and \edtextnow are used to print critical footnotes on the right side, while refering to the text on the left side.

macros.name: firstlinenum
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between successive numbered lines.

macros.name: firstlinenum*
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between successive numbered lines.

macros.name: Lcolwidth
macros.doc: The lengths \Lcolwidth and \Rcolwidth are the widths of the left and right columns, respectively.

macros.name: Leftpagehook
macros.doc: When typesetting parallel pages, the \Leftpagehook and \Rightpagehook macros are executed each time reledpar switches to Left / Right page.

macros.name: lineation
macros.doc: Lines can be numbered either by page, by pstart or by section; you specify this using the \lineation{⟨arg⟩} macro, where ⟨arg⟩ is either page, pstart or section.

macros.name: lineation*
macros.doc: Lines can be numbered either by page, by pstart or by section; you specify this using the \lineation{⟨arg⟩} macro, where ⟨arg⟩ is either page, pstart or section.

macros.name: lineationR
macros.doc: \lineationR{⟨word⟩} is the macro used to select the lineation system for right texts.

macros.name: linenumberstyle
macros.doc: You can use \linenumberstyle{⟨style⟩} to change the numbering style.

macros.name: linenumberstyle*
macros.doc: You can use \linenumberstyle{⟨style⟩} to change the numbering style.

macros.name: linenumberstyleR
macros.doc: \linenumberstyleR is the equivalent of reledmac \linenumberstyle for right text.

macros.name: linenumincrement
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between successive numbered lines.

macros.name: linenumincrement*
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between successive numbered lines.

macros.name: linenummarginColumns
macros.doc: The \linenummarginColumns macro overrides the definition of the line margin when typesetting in parallel columns.

macros.name: linenummarginColumns*
macros.doc: The \linenummarginColumns macro overrides the definition of the line margin when typesetting in parallel columns.

macros.name: linenummarginR
macros.doc: \linenummarginR applies directly for right side, while \linenummargin* applies for both side.

macros.name: linenumOnlyPagesForColumns
macros.doc: \linenumOnlyPagesForColumns and \linenumOnlyPagesForColumnsR make the line numbers be printed only on left/right page for the left/right column.

macros.name: linenumOnlyPagesForColumnsR
macros.doc: \linenumOnlyPagesForColumns and \linenumOnlyPagesForColumnsR make the line numbers be printed only on left/right page for the left/right column.

macros.name: maxchunks
macros.doc: The macro \maxchunks{⟨num⟩} specifies the maximum number of chunks within the left or right texts.

macros.name: memorydump
macros.doc: The command \memorydump effectively performs an \endumbering immediately followed by a \beginnumbering while not restarting the numbering sequence.

macros.name: onlysideX
macros.doc: Use \Xonlyside[⟨s⟩]{⟨p⟩} to set critical notes, and \onlysideX[⟨s⟩]{⟨p⟩} to set familiar notes.

macros.name: onlysideX
macros.doc: Use \Xonlyside[⟨s⟩]{⟨p⟩} to set critical notes, and \onlysideX[⟨s⟩]{⟨p⟩} to set familiar notes.

macros.name: Pages
macros.doc: The command \Pages typesets the texts in the previous pair of Leftside and Rightside environments.

macros.name: Pages
macros.doc: The command \Pages typesets the texts in the previous pair of Leftside and Rightside environments.

macros.name: Rcolwidth
macros.doc: The lengths \Lcolwidth and \Rcolwidth are the widths of the left and right columns, respectively.

macros.name: Rightpagehook
macros.doc: When typesetting parallel pages, the \Leftpagehook and \Rightpagehook macros are executed each time reledpar switches to Left / Right page.

macros.name: sidenotemargin
macros.doc: The \sidenotemargin defines the margin of the sidenote for either left or right side, depending on the current environment.

macros.name: sidenotemargin*
macros.doc: The \sidenotemargin defines the margin of the sidenote for either left or right side, depending on the current environment.

macros.name: sidenotemarginR
macros.doc: The \sidenotemarginR defines the margin of the sidenote for the right side.

macros.name: sublinenumberstyle
macros.doc: \sublinenumberstyle{⟨style⟩} can be used to change the numbering style of sub-line numbers, which is normally arabic numerals.

macros.name: sublinenumberstyle*
macros.doc: \sublinenumberstyle{⟨style⟩} can be used to change the numbering style of sub-line numbers, which is normally arabic numerals.

macros.name: Xonlyside
macros.doc: Use \Xonlyside[⟨s⟩]{⟨p⟩} to set critical notes, and \onlysideX[⟨s⟩]{⟨p⟩} to set familiar notes.

macros.name: Xonlyside
macros.doc: Use \Xonlyside[⟨s⟩]{⟨p⟩} to set critical notes, and \onlysideX[⟨s⟩]{⟨p⟩} to set familiar notes.

envs.name: astanza
envs.doc: This is roughly an environmental form of \stanza, which treats its stanza-like contents as a single chunk.

envs.name: astanza
envs.doc: This is roughly an environmental form of \stanza, which treats its stanza-like contents as a single chunk.

envs.name: pairs
envs.doc: Numbered text that is to be set in columns must be within a pairs environment.
